body:
Triage (first-touch grading, 2026-08-16): `finding` → `pm:on-hold`.

**Reason**: label-only docs polish with zero measured pull — no gate breaks, no reader defect beyond imprecision; a standalone label-sweep PR does not clear the startup-scope bar today.

**Restart condition (named trigger files)**: the next PR touching any of
- `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx`
- `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`
- `content/docs/kernel/index.mdx`

carries the relabel as a **declared rider** (relabel each link to the page's own title, `Deployment Overview`; give the two "Cloud Deployment" sites a trailing clause naming which lifecycle the reader is being sent to). `domain:devx` seat: intersect dispatch file surfaces against this list pre-dispatch and name this card when hit.

**Provenance**: seat-graded (triage Routine); no maintainer ruling involved.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine。

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Hold released → `pm:queue` (triage seat, session `session_014qTKTqjme5Fp5BH9iRmy6t`, rider-clause audit): "the next PR touching" happened twice without the rider riding — `hook-bodies.mdx` was touched one hour after the hold (#8996) and `kernel/index.mdx` on 2026-08-18 (#9634); all three labels are verbatim unchanged on origin/main. Three mechanical label edits stop waiting on a mechanism that isn't firing. Release double-checks passed.

**Claimed by the `domain:devx` PM seat** (#6023), session `session_01DdCnBGcHeufjrq7drTD3wt`, branch `claude/issue-8984-deployment-index-link-labels`.

Taken by age, after the lane's `priority:p1` (#10032, landed as #10466) and its highest `Bug` (#10288).

`fold-or-serial`: **serial, folds with nothing.** Verified by file, not by keyword — the only `content/docs/**` file touched by anything this seat has in flight is `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx` (PR #10450). This card's three files are untouched.

⛔ Two older cards were skipped ahead of it, each for a stated reason rather than by preference: **#8331** is serial behind PR #10441 (both edit `.github/workflows/lint.yml`), and **#8901** is [both a design act and serial behind the stuck PR #10396](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/8901#issuecomment-5363517681).

Each replacement was fitted to its own clause rather than globally substituted: setup-app's Related bullets take no trailing period, hook-bodies' See-also bullets do, and kernel's is mid-sentence prose whose surrounding words ('running the kernel in production') already name the half, so only the label token changed. Line drift from the card: hook-bodies is at 346 on current main, not 345 (card's numbers were as of 8b9eba51b). Labels only - no link target, heading, page structure or meta.json title touched. skip-changeset applied and read back; content/ is outside every pnpm-workspace glob and its only consumer apps/docs is private:true, so nothing here is a published package surface.",

Gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` with NO paths passed (it derives its own change set from the merge base) - 12 families, re-derived at the final commit as identical, no additions. All 12 plus check:nul-bytes exited 0; exit codes captured by redirect-then-capture, never through a pipe. Quoting each gate's own verdict line, not $?: check-doc-anchors -> '256 internal #fragment link(s) across 400 source file(s) all resolve to a real heading'; check-docs-redirects -> 'OK (apps/docs/redirects.mjs: 92 entries -- 89 page destination(s) resolved against content/docs, 3 wildcard, 0 outside the /docs route space)'; check-runtime-services-index -> '8 chapter page(s) vs meta.json \"pages\", 8 chapter-list bullet(s) and 8 kernel/index.mdx table row(s) ... all enumerations agree' (this one reads the file I edited); check-docs-audit-scope -> 'docs-accuracy-audit scope is in sync with content/docs/: 181 hand-written doc(s)'; check-role-word -> 'OK, no new occurrences of the reserved word'; check-published-readme-links -> '152 outbound link(s) across 60 published markdown file(s)'; check-nul-bytes -> 'OK (scanned 6141 text file(s) ... no raw ASCII control bytes)'. The four spec-filtered gates (check:liveness, check:empty-state, check:strictness-ledger, check:variant-docs) each echoed '@objectstack/spec@17.1.0 check:...' in their logs, confirming a real run rather than a zero-match --filter no-op that would have exited 0 having run nothing. No unit tests exist for docs prose; lychee link-checking is CI-only and no link target moved. Edits were proven on disk in both directions before being trusted (removed strings now grep to 0 tree-wide, injected strings grep to exactly 1 each) rather than relying on the edit tool's exit code. Heavy steps (pnpm install, gate union) went through scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh; one union attempt returned the queue-timeout VERDICT (exit 99) behind another agent's 610s turbo build and was retried to completion rather than reported from the pre-commit run.",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": [
    "filed as #10476: kernel/index.mdx:46 labels /docs/plugins as 'Plugins & Packages' (the section title from plugins/meta.json) while the page it lands on is titled 'Plugin System' - same shape as this card, different target, on the very same line I edited. Deliberately NOT swept in: the correct shape is not pinned by evidence (section-reference vs page-reference is an unmade judgement), and content/docs/index.mdx's module grid uses section titles uniformly for section-root links even where they diverge from the page title (Views & Apps -> UI Engine, API & SDK -> API Overview), which argues the other way. Filed unassigned with both readings and named explicitly in the PR body so the untouched label on an edited line does not read as an oversight."
  ],
  "census": {
    "positive_control": "Proven before trusting any zero-hit: grep -rn '(/docs/deployment)' over the three named files returned exactly the three known instances.",
    "expression": "grep -rnE '/docs/deployment([^/[:alnum:]_-]|$)' content/  (verified byte-identical, diff clean, to the -P negative-lookahead form actually run; the -P literal cannot be carried in GitHub body text because the sanitizer strips its exclamation mark - confirmed on the RENDERED page, then repaired)",
    "result": "9 links to the index across 8 files - 3 defective (fixed), 1 examined and cleared, 5 already correct. So three was what the card noticed, not the count.",
    "already_correct": "api/environment-routing.mdx:128, deployment/single-project-mode.mdx:113, deployment/self-hosting.mdx:14, deployment/self-hosting.mdx:436, deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx:221 - all 'Deployment Overview'. self-hosting.mdx:436 already carries a trailing clause naming both lifecycles and was used as the in-repo precedent for the two rewritten clauses.",
    "examined_and_cleared": "content/docs/index.mdx:51 - a Card in the '## Platform modules' grid labelled 'Deployment & Operations'. Left alone deliberately: that grid uses section titles for section-root links throughout, including where they diverge from the page title (Views & Apps -> UI Engine, API & SDK -> API Overview). Changing only the deployment card would break a uniform nine-card convention, and re-titling the grid is a restructure rather than a relabel.",
    "outside_content": "None. The same expression over *.md/*.mdx/*.ts/*.tsx/*.json outside content/ (excluding node_modules) returned nothing. No trailing-slash or #fragment forms of the index link exist.",
    "not_touched": "content/docs/releases/** (release-owned, review-only - no deployment-label defect seen there) and content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx (held by open PR #10450)."
  }
}
